stem: A bag contains $20$ balls of the same size: black, yellow, white and red. solution: The four probabilities add up to $1$. So $P(\text{red}) = 1 - \dfrac{1}{20} - \dfrac{4}{5} = \dfrac{3}{20}$. Then $P(\text{yellow}) = \dfrac{7}{10} - \dfrac{3}{20} = \dfrac{11}{20}$ and $P(\text{white}) = \dfrac{4}{5} - \dfrac{11}{20} = \dfrac{1}{4}$. The options use the same three numbers in different orders, so the order yellow, white, red decides the answer.
